_doc: Edit tiles and activity only. Tile fields: id, title (Marathi label), tag (tiny English caption, optional), icon (coins|smartphone|sprout|clapperboard|scissors|images|activity|shield-check|radio|clock-3|gem), accent (gold|teal|blue|pink|purple|orange|green), state (ok = LIVE green, warn = WAITING amber, bad = ALERT red, idle = IDLE grey), badge (optional text to replace the state label), headline (one short line), note (optional), updated_at (UTC ISO time of the change), wide (optional true = full width). Tile order is display order. activity: list of {at: UTC ISO time (optional), text}; newest six show, the rates publish line is added automatically. Keep text short. No rate-source names.
